source: sanitized Windows vendor-API input-gain encoding plus live write/read-back/restore validation

golden_encoding.encoding: signed little-endian Q8.8; endpoint state byte is zero above -7 dB

live_validation.procedure: read original; write a temporary 1 dB delta; read back; restore original; read back
live_validation.result: both temporary values and both restored values matched

limitations: The successful write used the registered Windows vendor API; the underlying USB setup packet has not been captured with USBPcap.
Only firmware 0x018A and Input 1/2 preamp gain are approved by this fixture.
Failure behavior and concurrent Lewitt Control Center interaction remain unverified.
